comparisons.interpretation: Both support expanding affordable housing and strengthening public housing. Aviles specifies renter and small-homeowner recovery, protecting public housing, and affordable construction; Painter specifies fully funding and repairing NYCHA housing and creating 100% affordable housing. The shared claim is grounded in these full-answer mechanisms, not only housing-right framing.

Both support expanding affordable housing and strengthening NYCHA. Aviles specifies renter recovery, public-housing protection, and affordable construction; Camarena specifies full NYCHA funding plus permanently affordable, supportive, and cooperative housing. The overlap is concrete public/affordable-housing investment, with different additional mechanisms.
